spec_match.rationale: Runs the literal WPT cases: the AccentColorText black/white triplet (rgb(255,165,0)/rgb(245,245,245)→black, rgb(10,10,10)→white), accent-color: AccentColor cycle-breaking to the parent, and currentcolor indirection.

interactive.rationale: Two probe buttons execute the real getComputedStyle reads against the live tiles and nested boxes; a select switches the child's accent-color declaration between the cyclic, explicit and currentColor cases.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the WPT-pinned contrast flips, cycle-breaking and forced-colors coverage; delivered, with forced-colors handled honestly as a manual case.

edge_cases.rationale: This is the edge-case page: cycles, currentcolor, UA-choice tile with no pinned expectation, forced-colors detection via matchMedia with a manual-observation disclaimer, and per-tier honest verdicts.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the cyclic WPT and sibling concepts; the code block quotes the exact WPT expectations.

conformance.rationale: The suite's contrast, cycle-breaking, currentcolor and forced-colors (manual) assertions are exactly this page's cases.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven on Chromium 141: both buttons and the select produce honest 'not parsed' verdicts (including the detail that the dropped AccentColor declaration leaves the child's computed accent-color at the explicit parent value), console clean, both viewports screenshot-verified; the pass verdicts themselves require Chrome 158.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the tier, the WPT triplet outcome on the follows tier, cycle-breaking, and the explicit unavailable fallbacks.

design_system.rationale: Tiles carry a labelled stone/charcoal fallback pair (AA) until the UA paints them with its own guaranteed-contrast pair; verdict colours use the emerald-dark/rose accents on light backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons and a labelled select, 44px targets, tile expectations written in visible text (not colour-only), single polite readout region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Tiles wrap into a 2×2 grid at 360×740 DPR3 with no overflow; desktop lays them in a row; both classes screenshot-verified.

openQuestions.title: Run the WPT triplet and cycle probe on real Chrome 158+/Canary
openQuestions.detail: All four verdict paths (triplet PASS lines, cycle PASS to parent accent, currentcolor mirror) were only executable to their honest unsupported branches on Chromium 141. Verify the PASS branches and the telemetry asserts on Chrome 158.

openQuestions.title: Manually observe forced-colors mode
openQuestions.detail: The page reports matchMedia('(forced-colors: active)') but the actual forced-palette override of AccentColor/AccentColorText (the spec's 'unless Forced Colors Mode is enabled' clause) needs a manual session with forced colors enabled — also the conformance suite's one manual assertion.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable in this environment; the select/button semantics were exercised via CDP only, per project rule 7b this is not full browser a11y verification.

guidanceConsulted.query: communicating pass/fail state without relying on colour alone
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never encode state in colour alone; pair colour with text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every tile carries its expectation as visible text ('→ expect black'), and verdict lines spell out PASS/DIFFERS/not-parsed in words; the v-pass/v-fail colours are reinforcement only.

guidanceConsulted.query: wrapping tile grid without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Flex-wrap fixed-width tiles so they reflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The .tiles row flex-wraps 7.2rem tiles into a 2×2 grid at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: touch target sizing for probe buttons
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons and the select declare min-height: 44px.

summary: Edge-case page verified on Chromium 141 headless: both probes and the cyclic select run their honest unsupported branches with precise explanations (including the dropped-declaration detail), forced-colors state is reported, console clean, both viewports pass. The WPT pass branches await Chrome 158.
